title: AFRICOM Strikes Al-Shabaab Weapons Warehouse in Sanaag Region, 80km SW of Bosaso
detail: US Africa Command conducted an airstrike on September 17, 2026 targeting an Al-Shabaab conventional weapons storage warehouse in the Sanaag region, approximately 80 kilometers southwest of Bosaso, in coordination with the Federal Government of Somalia and Somali Armed Forces. Regional reporting identified the targeted facility as being in the Markad area of the Al-Madow-Golis mountains, where Al-Shabaab had reportedly stockpiled weapons and ammunition. AFRICOM did not disclose casualty figures or unit/asset details, citing operational security, and said the strike was intended to degrade Al-Shabaab's ability to threaten US forces and citizens abroad. It is AFRICOM's fifth publicly disclosed Somalia strike in roughly three weeks, following the September 4, 5, 8 and 14 strikes in southern Somalia.
